repository_gate.test: src/i18n/__tests__/catalogues.test.ts:187 ('ships no locale the runtime cannot render')
repository_gate.detail: By design until activation: docs/i18n.md says a catalogue directory is not activation, and catalogues.test.ts requires every on-disk catalogue directory to be a SHIPPED_LOCALE. ./node_modules/.bin/vitest run src/i18n -> 1 failed | 87 passed, with zh-CN in the received directory list while SHIPPED_LOCALES is en, fr, es. It goes green when the wave flips SHIPPED_LOCALES after every group's audit passes (which then needs a measured SUGGESTION_CHAR_BUDGET['zh-CN'] entry); the fr and es waves flipped inside their own changes. Until then a branch that commits the zh-CN directory carries a red suite.
